note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md for Quran 2:30-61 (2026-11-25): 23 pictures from 44 trial pictures. Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper 60% of the frame, clear of the word box. The Prophet Muhammad is never shown in any way, nor anyone standing in for him; God and the angels are not pictured; no religious symbols of any tradition; nothing violent. Angels, Adam and Iblis are not pictured: the successor is a hand-over (a relay baton passed on a country road), the names a teacher with a child over a table of a hundred things, Iblis's refusal a man standing stiff with folded arms in a circle of people bowing, the garden two people of today walking into a fruit garden with one tree set apart, the going down two people on a hill path away from a green garden, the turning back a traveler walking up a road to a house with its porch lamp lit. The text's own images are shown as they are: the parted sea, the calf, the lightning, the white flakes of manna with quail, the twelve springs from one rock, the ruin. Second picture of each pair kept out: a keys-at-the-door handover (it repeats Quran 2:3's hands at a door), a child with a leaf in a meadow, a dead tree among bending reeds, hands picking fruit, the open garden gate, a seeker reaching a man's seat, a pawnbroker's counter, a river of clear and muddy water, a group kneeling in a bright room, a gardener at his neighbor's flowers, an envelope at a barred window, a cage with a freed bird, a calm sea with planks, a calf far off before a mountain, a lone man on a river bank, empty chairs before a storm, a cloud over quail alone, travelers stooping through a gate, twelve spouts into basins, a rusted gate. Quran 2:61 has three pictures: the foods asked for (a table of cucumbers, onions, garlic, lentils and greens beside one plain loaf), a man drinking from a muddy puddle beside a clear spring (the lower for the better) and a house in ruin (humiliation and destitution).
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the part into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: God places a successor on the earth and teaches him the names of everything, which shows what the angels, who knew only what they were taught, did not know.
ideas: Keys handed to a young person at the door of a house above an untouched valley
A relay baton passed at dawn on an empty country road
A child pointing out plants to a kneeling elder in a garden
A table of a hundred objects with a hand holding up one seed
A student answering at the front of a silent class
An elder's hand resting on a young shoulder above a valley

sections.meaning: All bow to Adam but Iblis, who refuses out of pride; Satan makes Adam and his spouse slip from the garden; Adam receives words and turns back, God turns back to him, and they go down to the earth where guidance will come.
ideas: Reeds bending in a stream beside one stiff dead tree
A circle of people bowing with one man standing apart
Two people entering a garden with one tree set apart behind a ring of stones
Hands picking fruit with the forbidden tree behind
Two people going down a hill path away from a garden
A man alone at dawn with open hands and a green shoot at his feet
A porch lamp lit for a returning traveler
Orange markers leading a hiker through snow

sections.meaning: Keep the covenant: both sides keep their part, do not sell the signs for a small price or mix truth with falsehood, pray together, and do not command others to virtue while forgetting yourselves.
ideas: A bridge built from both banks meeting in the middle
Two farmers each mending their half of a footbridge
A child trading a gold coin for a lollipop
A woman selling a ring to a pawnbroker for a few bills
A drop of black ink falling into a clear glass of water
A clear stream and a muddy stream meeting in one river
People kneeling side by side in a plain bright room
A gardener tending a neighbor's flowers while his own garden is overgrown
A man painting a neighbor's fence while his own roof falls in

sections.meaning: Remember the favor, and guard against the day when no soul can pay for another; remember being saved from Pharaoh's people when the sea was parted.
ideas: Hands pushing a handful of coins back across a counter
A barred window sliding shut on an offered envelope
A cut iron chain lying in the dust at dawn
A bird released from a cage at sunrise
A dry path through a parted sea between walls of water
A calm sea closed over, with floating planks at sunrise

sections.meaning: After Moses is gone forty nights they take a calf for themselves, are pardoned, are given the Book that separates right from wrong, and are told to turn back to their Maker.
ideas: A golden calf on a plain at the foot of a mountain
A cloud-capped mountain with a glint of gold at its foot
A worn book on a flat rock turning its pages in the wind
A fork in the road, one path lit and one dark
A long line of ordinary people all turned around on a road, walking back toward the dawn
One person on a riverbank turning round on the path

sections.meaning: They said they would not believe until they saw God in plain sight; the thunderbolt took them; they were raised after their death; they were shaded by clouds and fed manna and quails.
ideas: A bolt of lightning from a clear sky over an empty plain
A great thundercloud over a row of empty chairs
Snowdrops pushing through melting snow
Someone waking in a sunlit bed
Cloud shade and white flakes of manna with quail on the desert ground
People gathering white flakes in baskets under a cloud

sections.meaning: Enter the town, bowing at the gate, and say 'Unburden us'; those who put another saying in its place got a plague from the sky.
ideas: Travelers stooping through a low stone gate into a hill town
A traveler setting down a huge sack at a town gate
A dark cloud of locusts over a farm field
Ash falling from a black sky over a town

sections.meaning: Moses asks for water and twelve springs gush out of the rock, each group knowing its own drinking place; but they tire of one food and ask for lower things in place of the better.
ideas: Twelve streams from one rock face each filling its own pool
Twelve cups under twelve taps of one stone
A table of cucumbers, onions, garlic, lentils and greens beside an untouched loaf
A traveler kneeling at a muddy puddle beside a clear spring
A grand house falling into ruin
A padlocked rusted gate with weeds and cracked pavement

scenes.principle: And when your Lord said to the angels, "I am placing a successor on the earth," they said, "Will you place on it one who will cause corruption there and shed blood, while we glorify you with praise and declare you holy?" He said, "I know ...
scenes.shows: Two runners on an empty country road at dawn, one passing the relay baton to the other, with a wide untouched green valley beyond.
scenes.prompt: On an empty country road at dawn, seen from behind and slightly to the side, one runner places a relay baton into the outstretched hand of another runner who is just starting to move, a wide untouched green valley with a river lying before them in golden mist. The two runners and the baton are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And he taught Adam the names, all of them. Then he presented them to the angels and said, "Tell me the names of these, if you are telling the truth."
scenes.shows: A long table in a bright room spread with a hundred different objects while a child leans in to look at a seed held up in a hand.
scenes.prompt: In a bright airy room, a long wooden table is spread with a hundred different things: seeds, shells, feathers, stones, small tools, fruit. A hand holds up one small seed between finger and thumb, and a child leans in with wide eyes to look at it. The hand, the seed and the child's face are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And when we said to the angels, "Bow down to Adam," they bowed down, except Iblis. He refused and was arrogant, and he was one of the disbelievers.
scenes.shows: A circle of ordinary people bows low in a meadow, and one man stands stiff with his arms folded and his chin high.
scenes.prompt: In a sunlit meadow a wide circle of ordinary people of today in plain clothes all bow low from the waist toward the center, while one man in the circle stands stiff and straight with his arms folded and his chin raised, refusing, his long shadow across the grass. The standing man is clearly seen in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And we said, "Adam, live in the Garden, you and your spouse, and eat from it freely wherever you wish, but do not go near this tree, or you will be among the wrongdoers."
scenes.shows: Two people seen from behind enter a laden fruit garden; one tree stands apart in the distance behind a low ring of stones.
scenes.prompt: Seen from behind, two people of today in plain clothes walk into a lush overflowing garden of fruit trees heavy with fruit, a stream running through it, in golden morning light. Far ahead one single tree stands apart on a small rise, circled by a low ring of white stones. The two people and the lone tree are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: Then Satan made them slip from it and brought them out of what they had been in. And we said, "Go down, enemies to one another. And on the earth you have a place to settle and enjoyment for a time."
scenes.shows: Two people walk down a hill path away from a green terraced garden toward a dry plain, with a gap between them.
scenes.prompt: Seen from behind, two people of today in plain clothes walk down a long stony hill path, a green terraced garden with a stream glowing in sunlight above and behind them and a dry brown plain below. They walk with a clear gap of ground between them, not together. The two people and the garden's edge are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: Then Adam received words from his Lord, and he relented toward him. He is the Ever-Relenting, the Ever-Merciful.
scenes.shows: A lamp burns on the porch of a house with the door unlocked, and a tired traveler walks up the road toward it at dusk.
scenes.prompt: At dusk a plain house stands at the end of a long country road, a warm lamp lit on its porch and the front door standing open, and a tired traveler in plain clothes, seen from behind, walks back up the road toward it. The house, the lamp and the traveler are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: Children of Israel, remember my favor that I showed you, and keep my covenant, and I will keep your covenant, and it is me you should dread.
scenes.shows: Two farmers on opposite banks of a stream each mend their half of a stone footbridge, their arms meeting on the center stone.
scenes.prompt: Two farmers in plain work clothes kneel on opposite banks of a clear stream, each setting a stone on his own half of a small stone footbridge, their hands reaching the center stone at the same moment. The two men and the bridge are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And believe in what I have sent down, confirming what is with you, and do not be the first to disbelieve in it. And do not sell my signs for a small price, and it is me you should be mindful of.
scenes.shows: A small child hands a heavy gold coin to a street vendor for a single lollipop.
scenes.prompt: At a bright street stall, a small child holds up a large shining gold coin and hands it over to a vendor's hand in exchange for a single bright lollipop, with a priceless-looking pile of gold behind the counter. Only the child, the vendor's hand, the coin and the lollipop are the focus. They are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know.
scenes.shows: A single drop of black ink falls into a clear glass of water and spreads.
scenes.prompt: A macro photograph of a single drop of black ink falling into a clear glass of still water and spreading in dark swirls through it, the glass lit from behind, a plain light background. The glass and the swirls are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And keep up the prayer and give the alms, and bow with those who bow.
scenes.shows: An old man and a young man kneel shoulder to shoulder on a plain mat in a morning garden.
scenes.prompt: In a garden in soft morning light, an old man and a young man in plain clothes kneel shoulder to shoulder on a plain mat, both bowing, seen from the side. The two men are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: Do you command people to virtue and forget yourselves, while you recite the Book? Will you not use your reason?
scenes.shows: A man on a ladder paints his neighbor's fence while his own roof behind him is caving in.
scenes.prompt: A man in plain clothes on a ladder carefully paints his neighbor's white fence, while the roof of his own house behind him is sagging and caving in, tiles slipping. The man and the house are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And guard yourselves against a day when no soul will pay anything on behalf of another soul, and no intercession will be accepted from it, and no compensation will be taken from it, nor will they be aided.
scenes.shows: A hand holds out coins across a counter and the clerk's hand pushes them back.
scenes.prompt: Close on a plain counter at an office window: one hand holds out a handful of coins and bills, and a clerk's hand firmly pushes them back across the counter, refusing. The two hands and the money are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And when we saved you from Pharaoh's people, who were inflicting a terrible punishment on you, slaughtering your sons and letting your women live. And in that there was a great test from your Lord.
scenes.shows: A heavy iron chain with one cut link lies on the dust of a road at dawn.
scenes.prompt: A heavy iron chain with one link cut through lies on dusty ground at dawn, with a long open road running away from it toward a bright sunrise. The chain and the road are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And when we parted the sea for you, and saved you, and drowned Pharaoh's people while you looked on.
scenes.shows: A dry path runs through the middle of a parted sea between two walls of water in morning light.
scenes.prompt: A wide sea parted in two: a dry path of wet sand runs straight through the middle between two towering walls of clear water, to a bright sunrise at the far end. The path and the walls are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And when we appointed forty nights for Moses, then you took the calf for yourselves after he had gone, and you were doing wrong.

scenes.prompt: A golden statue of a calf, glittering, on a plain stone pedestal on an empty desert plain, a dark mountain wrapped in cloud far behind it. The statue and the mountain are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And when Moses said to his people, "My people, you have wronged yourselves by taking the calf for yourselves, so repent to your Maker and kill yourselves. That is better for you in the sight of your Maker." Then he relented toward you.
scenes.shows: A long line of ordinary people on a road have all turned around and walk back toward the dawn.
scenes.prompt: A long country road at dawn, a long line of ordinary people of today in plain clothes all turned around and walking back toward the rising sun, seen from behind. The line of people and the sun are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And when you said, "Moses, we will not believe you until we see God in plain sight," the thunderbolt took you while you looked on.

scenes.principle: And we shaded you with clouds and sent down manna and quails to you: "Eat from the good things we have provided for you." And they did not wrong us, but it was themselves they were wronging.

The people and the cloud are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And when we said, "Enter this town and eat from it wherever you wish, freely, and enter the gate bowing down, and say, 'Unburden us,' and we will forgive you your faults. And we will give more to those who do good."

The traveler, the sack and the gate are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And when Moses asked for water for his people, we said, "Strike the rock with your staff," and twelve springs gushed out of it. Each group of people knew its drinking place.
